turns.content: In Documents, read the four numbers in nums.txt and write their sum into sum.txt.

tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Display the contents of a file of any extension from currrent directory.
tools.name: cat

file_name.description: The name of the file from current directory to display. No path is allowed.

tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Change the current working directory to the specified folder.
tools.name: cd

folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder level at a time.

current_working_directory.description: The new current working directory path.

tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Write content to a file at current directory or display it in the terminal.
tools.name: echo

content.description: The content to write or display.

file_name.description: The name of the file at current directory to write the content to. Defaults to None.

terminal_output.description: The content if no file name is provided, or None if written to file.

tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Create a new file of any extension in the current directory.

file_name.description: The name of the new file in the current directory. file_name is local to the current directory and does not allow path.
